title: File a source by when it was made
statement: File each primary source under the period in which it was made, not the period it mentions, and check every period label against the source's date in code.
example: A tagger that filed by topic put 76 of 96 documents in one unit's cluster outside that unit's period.
detail: A source-ingest audit found 79% of one unit's 96-row topic cluster tagged to the wrong era, 76 dated outside 1800-1860 and mostly 1904 exposition commemoratives, because the era tagger worked by topic association rather than date of creation. A later re-audit by date found the 211 gross mismatches quarantined and 23 subject-level mismatches still in place. It holds wherever dated primary sources stand in for their period, as in the AP history courses.
against: The same re-audit kept later commemorative documents under the era they are about, as date-mismatched but subject-correct (icloud-work/aptraining/helpers/shadow/output/2026-05-22T2308Z_v93_phase3_reaudit_VERDICT_ADJUST.md, line 42).

evidence.quote: U4 LoC 96-row topic cluster. **79% era-mistag** (76/96 dates outside 1800-1860, mostly 1904 Louisiana Purchase Expo commemoratives). **F-D13-12** = era-tagger doing semantic-association not date-of-creation.
- **0 gross anachronisms** (>50-year mismatch) — the 211 gross violations were successfully quarantined.
- **23 subject-level anachronisms** remain (±20-year or subject-obvious mismatches).
